Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. Before Tuesday's victory the European side had reached the round-of-16 at the last three World Cups, but heroics from goalkeeper Gregor Kobel ended that run and helped them reach this stage for the first time in 72 years

Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. Before Tuesday's victory the European side had reached the round-of-16 at the last three World Cups, but heroics from goalkeeper Gregor Kobel ended that run and helped them reach this stage for the first time in 72 years

programme.desc: Argentina v Switzerland (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the fourth quarter-final, which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. Before Tuesday's victory the European side had reached the round-of-16 at the last three World Cups, but heroics from goalkeeper Gregor Kobel ended that run and helped them reach this stage for the first time in 72 years

programme.desc: Coverage of the second semi-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The corresponding stage of the tournament in Qatar four years ago resulted in two decisive scorelines, firstly with Argentina beating Croatia 3-0 on the back of stellar performances from Lionel Messi and Julian Alvarez, with Messi scoring from the spot and providing the assist for both goals in Alvarez's brace. That was followed by France triumphing 2-0 over a spirited Morocco who pushed the 2018 champions all the way in what was the first-ever semi-final appearance by an African nation. The Atlas Lions were unfortunate to suffer the loss of Nayef Aguerd and Romain Saiss to injury in the first-half, and saw Jawad El Yamiq's overhead kick tipped on to the post by France goalkeeper Hugo Lloris, and it proved to be the clinical finishing of Theo Hernandez and Randal Kolo Muani that settled the contest in the favour of Les Bleus

programme.title: Star Performance

programme.title: The Switch

programme.title: The Cheaters

programme.title: A Family At War

programme.title: Hannay

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: A Question of Storage. 1964. Stars Kate Allit, Brian Blessed & Joseph Brady. Smith and Weir discover systematic robberies with everything from suits to TV sets stolen.

programme.title: Public Eye

programme.title: Angel

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Fair and the Fallen. 1954. Stars Ron Randell, Jean Aubrey & Josephine Douglas. A young girl's jealous infatuation for her music teacher brings him under suspicions of murder.

programme.title: The Rogues

programme.title: What the Butler Saw

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Enjoy English beat band Freddie and the Dreamers as they perform the fantastic hit You Were Made For Me.

programme.title: Runaround

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Kama and Thabo find safe shelter but Dean and Nina are being pursued by King Ram.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Hostages. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Annoyed by Tell's activities, Gessler issues orders to have the archer arrested but Tell has disappeared.

programme.title: Britain Swings to Bowling 1969
programme.desc: A short film from 1969 showing a group of friends enjoying their time at a bowling alley.

programme.title: Batman

programme.title: Captain Scarlet and the Mysterons
